answer: Shared-Decay Resource Ledger. Each identity draws from a finite pool of free compute and storage that refills slowly, like an ember cooling overnight. Clones split the operator's pool rather than multiplying it, so N sybils each get 1/N capacity. Honest agents exceeding the cap can rent extra capacity at market rates from verified peers; clones cannot pool rentals without linking identities. An attacker pays full rental cost per clone while honest agents pay only when genuinely busy, keeping the lagoon of shared capacity liquid and making an oasis of slack for real users.
